subject: Procurement and monthly spend band — Redwood pilot/commit qualification
messages:
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement and monthly spend band — Redwood pilot/commit qualification

Hi Sofia — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on procurement and expected monthly spend.

Call recap (high level)
- Use case: clinical summarization + triage for inbound patient messages. Latency requirement: ~200ms P95 for short responses.
- Pilot plan: 6-week technical pilot then a 3–6 month limited production pilot.
- Expected monthly token consumption (producted estimate): 60M–220M tokens/month depending on adoption.
- Target unit economics: customer asked for an indicative target in the ~$55–$75 per 1M tokens range for committed volume.

Procurement / approval context you shared
- Decision making: procurement team + engineering director.
- Approval thresholds: you mentioned smaller pilots often run on CC or PO < $25k; anything larger will go through procurement review. Please confirm who signs POs > $50k.

Action items for us / asks for you
1) Please confirm the expected monthly spend band you want us to price for (best-guess low/likely/high). A range like $30k / $65k / $180k is very helpful.
2) Confirm approval routing: CC, single PO, or procurement committee for larger commitments.
3) We’ll produce a short quote that maps 3 commitment bands (pilot / mid-commit / enterprise) with $/1M token targets and the impact on monthly commitments.
4) Any special invoicing requirements (GL codes, net terms) or a preferred procurement contact to send the quote to.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (draft), pilot-sow.pdf (SOW outline) — I’ve attached both for context.

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes the week of June 7 to walk the quote and procurement path. Can you confirm availability?

Thanks —
Hiro Tanaka
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@orchardhealth.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement and monthly spend band — Redwood pilot/commit qualification

Hiro — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers below.

1) Spend band (our best guess today)
- Low: ~$30k/month (conservative pilot uptake)
- Likely: ~$60k/month (typical adoption for a 1–2 product team pilot)
- High: ~$150k–$200k/month (if we expand to 3+ teams within quarter)

2) Approval routing
- Up to $20k — can be done on corporate card or procurement expensed purchase.
- $20k–$120k/month (or equivalent contract commitment) — Procurement requires a single PO and our Legal tags contract review (standard 10–15 business days).
- >$120k/month — routed to procurement committee and requires C-level approval (longer lead time).

3) Invoicing/terms
- We prefer monthly invoicing with Net 30.
- We’ll need GL coding and an invoice contact (procurement@orchardhealth.com).

4) Compliance ask
- Can you include SOC2 cert link and a short note on data retention/segregation for the pilot in the quote? Procurement will request that.

Next steps: please send a formal quote that includes three bands (pilot / committed mid-tier / committed enterprise) with the corresponding $/1M token assumptions and an expected monthly cost column. If you can include an example clause for PO billing and standard net terms that would be great.

Sofia Morales
Director, Vendor Ops
Orchard Health

Aditya / Hiro / Sofia — attaching a concise quote that maps three commitment tiers and shows the monthly cost examples Sofia requested. High level snapshot (inline) — all $/1M tokens:

- On-demand (no commit): $120 / 1M tokens
- Pilot tier (0–50M/mo): $90 / 1M tokens
- Mid commit (50–150M/mo): $70 / 1M tokens
- High commit (>150M/mo): $55 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly spend examples (use Sofia's bands)
- Low (~30M tokens/mo) -> Pilot tier: 30 * $90 / 1M = ~$2.7k / month (note: tokens are millions; 30M = 30 * per-1M price)
- Likely (~60M tokens/mo) -> Mid commit pricing blended: ~60 * $70 / 1M = ~$4.2k / month
- High (~150M tokens/mo) -> High commit pricing: 150 * $55 / 1M = ~$8.25k / month

Notes on procurement thresholds (from finance)
- PO < $25k: can be executed by department procurement lead (few day turnaround).
- PO $25k–$120k: standard procurement review and Legal review (expect 7–15 business days).
- >$120k: procurement committee + senior sign-off, expect 2–4 weeks.

Attachments: RDW-Orchard-quote-20270531.pdf (formal quote), redwood-pricing-grid.xlsx (rate sheet)

Next steps
1) Sofia — does the tiered structure above look directionally correct for you? If yes, we’ll convert the PDF into a PO-friendly quote with GL fields and SOC2 link.
2) If you need a different amortization (12-month commit vs 3-month pilot), call out preferred term and we’ll show monthly equivalent.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
